name: Devastate The Floor
body:
School: evocation [force]; Level: jester 4

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Prop: Pole

EFFECT

Range: Close (65 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Area: 35-ft.-line

Duration: 1 round

Saving Throw: Fortitude half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

Each creature in the line takes 2d8 points of force damage +1 point per caster level . The target’s speed is reduced by half until the end of your next turn. If you are wielding a pole, the target cannot voluntarily move from its current location instead of having its speed reduced to 0 until the end of your next turn.
